errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced approximately every 0.02
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not regularly spaced. For example, the interval between the first two ticks (0.71, 0.73) is 0.02, but the interval between the next two (0.73, 0.79) is 0.06.
The blue line for Final Accuracy starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.90 when the initial confidence is 0.71, not 0.95.

errors.text_span: then generally declining to about 0.90 by the end of the range
errors.evidence: The blue line for Final Accuracy does not show a general decline after its peak at 0.79; it fluctuates but remains high, mostly above 0.85. Furthermore, its final value at an initial confidence of 1.00 is approximately 0.98, not 0.90.
The green line representing Initial Accuracy has a dash-dotted style in the plot, not a dashed style. The orange line has the dashed style.

errors.text_span: then showing a decline to around 0.80 by the end
errors.evidence: The green line for Initial Accuracy ends at an accuracy value of approximately 0.90 at an initial confidence of 1.00, not 0.80.
The orange line representing Δ Accuracy has a dashed style in the plot, not a dash-dotted style. The green line has the dash-dotted style.
The description omits the presence of error bars, which are shown for every data point on all three lines and are a significant feature of a scientific plot.
